/* insertCmnFile1 - Lee JiSeob */
MERGE INTO
SAB880 C /* 웹서버 첨부파일 */
SAB820 C /* 첨부파일 */
USING DUAL ON (C.ATFINO = #{ATFINO})
WHEN MATCHED THEN
UPDATE SET MENU_NO = #{MENU_NO}, UP_MENU_NO = ( SELECT F.MENU_NO FROM SAB200 F /* 메뉴 */ WHERE F.MENU_LEVELA_NO = 1 START WITH F.MENU_NO = #{MENU_NO} CONNECT BY PRIOR F.UP_MENU_NO = F.MENU_NO ), SYS_NM = ( SELECT F.MENU_NM FROM SAB200 F /* 메뉴 */ WHERE F.MENU_LEVELA_NO = 1 START WITH F.MENU_NO = #{MENU_NO} CONNECT BY PRIOR F.UP_MENU_NO = F.MENU_NO ),
LAST_MDFR_ID = 'system',
LAST_MDFR_ID = #{USER_ID},
LAST_MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
INSERT ( ATFINO, MENU_NO, UP_MENU_NO, SYS_NM, FRST_RGTR_ID, FRST_REG_DT, LAST_MDFR_ID, LAST_MDFCN_DT ) VALUES ( #{ATFINO}, #{MENU_NO}, ( SELECT F.MENU_NO FROM SAB200 F /* 메뉴 */ WHERE F.MENU_LEVELA_NO = 1 START WITH F.MENU_NO = #{MENU_NO} CONNECT BY PRIOR F.UP_MENU_NO = F.MENU_NO ), ( SELECT F.MENU_NM FROM SAB200 F /* 메뉴 */ WHERE F.MENU_LEVELA_NO = 1 START WITH F.MENU_NO = #{MENU_NO} CONNECT BY PRIOR F.UP_MENU_NO = F.MENU_NO ),
'system',
#{USER_ID},
SYSDATE,
'system',
#{USER_ID},
SYSDATE )

/* insertCmnFile2 - Lee JiSeob */
INSERT INTO
SAB881 /* 웹서버 첨부파일 */
SAB821 /* 첨부파일 */
( ATFINO, MNG_SN, ATCMFL_CL_NM, REAL_FILE_NM, STRG_FILE_NM, STRG_COURS_NM, FILE_EXTN_NM, FILE_SZ, FILE_STTS_SE_CD, FRST_RGTR_ID, FRST_REG_DT, LAST_MDFR_ID, LAST_MDFCN_DT ) VALUES ( #{ATFINO},
(SELECT CASE COUNT(*) WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(MNG_SN) + 1 END FROM SAB881 WHERE ATFINO = #{ATFINO}), /* 웹서버 첨부파일 */
(SELECT CASE COUNT(*) WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(MNG_SN) + 1 END FROM SAB821 WHERE ATFINO = #{ATFINO}), /* WAS 첨부파일 */
#{ATCMFL_CL_NM}, #{REAL_FILE_NM}, #{STRG_FILE_NM}, #{STRG_COURS_NM}, #{FILE_EXTN_NM}, #{FILE_SZ}, #{FILE_STTS_SE_CD},
'system',
#{USER_ID},
SYSDATE,
'system',
#{USER_ID},
SYSDATE )

/* selectUnitTaskWork - Lee JiSeob */
SELECT D.CMMNS_CD_VALUE
FROM SAB200 C /* 메뉴 */, SAC100 D /* 공통코드 값 */
WHERE C.MENU_NO = ( SELECT E.MENU_NO FROM SAB200 E WHERE E.MENU_LEVELA_NO = 1 START WITH E.MENU_NO = #{MENU_NO} CONNECT BY PRIOR E.UP_MENU_NO = E.MENU_NO ) AND D.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD' AND D.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM = C.MENU_NM

/* selectFileDownloadHistoryList - Lee JiSeob */
SELECT DWNLD_SN, ATFINO, MNG_SN, ATCMFL_CL_NM, REAL_FILE_NM, STRG_FILE_NM, STRG_COURS_NM, FILE_SZ, FRST_RGTR_ID, FRST_RGTR_NM, TO_CHAR(FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS FRST_REG_DT, MENU_NM, UP_MENU_NM, PROGRM_ID
FROM ( SELECT DWNLD_SN, ATFINO, MNG_SN, ATCMFL_CL_NM, REAL_FILE_NM, STRG_FILE_NM, STRG_COURS_NM, FILE_SZ, FRST_RGTR_ID, DEC_B64(C##RG.SA_FN_GET_NAME(FRST_RGTR_ID)) AS FRST_RGTR_NM, FRST_REG_DT, MENU_NM, UP_MENU_NM, PROGRM_ID
FROM SAB510 /* 파일다운로드이력 */ ) M
AND REAL_FILE_NM LIKE '%' || #{FILENAME} || '%'
AND FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{DATE_FROM} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
AND FRST_REG_DT <= TO_DATE(#{DATE_TO} || '235959', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
AND MENU_NM LIKE '%' || #{MENU_NAME} || '%'
AND UP_MENU_NM LIKE '%' || #{UP_MENU_NAME} || '%'
AND FRST_RGTR_ID LIKE '%' || #{USER_ID} || '%'
AND FRST_RGTR_NM = #{USER_NAME}
AND ATFINO = #{ATFINO}
AND ATCMFL_CL_NM LIKE '%' || #{ATCMFL_CL_NM} || '%'
ORDER BY DWNLD_SN DESC
OFFSET #{OFFSET_IDX} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{ROW_COUNT} ROWS ONLY
